title: A Higher Standard - Near Downtown
description:
Cozy, quiet, and comfortable private guest suite in eclectic East Nashville. 8-min drive to downtown Nashville; 10-min drive to Opry Mills mall/Opryland Hotel/Grand Ole Opry! Walking distance to East Nashville favorites, such as The Tiger Bar & Nicoletto’s Italian Kitchen. We’re a short 5-min drive to the popular Five Points area. We’ve considered every detail as we've created this magical space with you in mind! Please take a look around — we look forward to hosting you!

Warmly,
Melissa

The space
Our private guest suite is attached to the rear of the main house. Off-street parking is available in the rear of the property, adjacent to the fire pit area. Our guest suite features a kitchenette, two full bathrooms, and a washer/dryer combo. Our guest suite contains two floors connected by a spiral staircase — each floor with a separate external entry door. The bedroom is on the bottom floor, which offers a queen TempurPedic mattress (not currently on adjustable bed frame). The living space on the top floor offers a daybed for flexible enjoyment of the space, serving as sleeping quarters for a 3rd guest. The blue chair in the living area extends into a chaise position, as well as lays flat to a sleeping position for one person. The overall space offers (3) beds to accommodate (4) guests.
